operation: Read-only comparison of matched frozen base-grid datasets; no simulation or training
difference: new zero-order-hold minus legacy linear; excludes common initial state

action_mapping.solver_environment_samples: e=[initial_temperature,a_0,a_1,...,a_(K-1)]; stored network control a_n = solver sample e_(n+1)
action_mapping.missing_context: Legacy linear transition depends on previous stored command a_(n-1) as well as current supplied command a_n. It does NOT use stored future command a_(n+1) on this interval.
action_mapping.markov_interpretation: For prescribed linear endpoint interpolation, generally use F(T_n,a_(n-1),a_n,p), or augment the state with current furnace temperature. A held-action F(T_n,a_n,p) requires the new zero-order-hold contract.

caveat: This measures the resulting difference between two action/integration protocols, not surrogate prediction error or experimental validation. ZOH also restarts the adaptive integrator at command changes; solver-tolerance differences can contribute.
